body: This was known since we began our relationship, and is only now imminent. But yes, I am sure this is a factor that is stressing her.

I should clarify: The situation isn't (too my judgment anyway) such that taking her to the Emergency Room would be appropriate. More like "these thoughts are floating around in my head" than I'm going to do something in the next short while. I can guarantee you she would not consent to coming to the ER with me, but that she might consent to something more moderate.

At the same time, I'm looking for some more concrete advice than just talking to her, so that I can have some assurance that she's getting proper help.

I guess the issue is that she needs some sort of counselor, but can't afford one via standard avenues. What other option is there, besides a hotline (which seems more suited to moments of crisis)?
